verdict.rationale: Google's docs say Veo turns images into short videos and claim character consistency with image inputs (veo-docs-8, veo-docs-9), and a user confirms animating an image through veo-2.0-generate-001 (veo-comm-18). However, a hands-on report says Whisk's video generation, which runs on Veo per veo-comm-16, redraws the whole source picture until it barely resembles the original (veo-comm-19). That directly contradicts the preservation the story requires. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of image-to-video fidelity controls, independent evidence that subject and composition are reliably preserved.
